ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio (~65:35) between central low-intensity black regions and distal high-intensity white patches.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central contiguous black region spanning the majority of both lobes. White patches on distal tips. Left tip contains two discrete dark circular spots. Right tip features complex mottling with dark streaks and gray tonal shifts.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Asymmetrical serration pattern. Left lobe shows fine, high-frequency peaks. Right lobe shows larger, more rounded scallop-like variations in pixel topography.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong upward sweep on both lobes. Trailing edge follows a generally linear path from notch to distal tip with localized topographic noise.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clustered high-contrast brown/tan pixel groups located at the extreme lateral tips. Two distinct circular dark spots on the white portion of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned dark linear disruptions visible on the right lobe's lateral white patch, oriented diagonally toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent clusters of textured, brown-pigmented barnacle colonies at the outer margins of both lobes.
